knownGaps: This record was authored from observed runs by the orchestrator; it does not re-execute them.

No separate human annotation was solicited for B1: LOCAL-CODEX-HANDOFF Phase 4 requires client-visible fields, not a human verdict; the assessment-value semantics (ABSTAIN-on-reputation, BRAIN_SOURCE_UNKNOWN fail-safe) were already annotated EXPECTED at B0 (see slice-verification-b0-executed.json humanVerifications). This is a B1 convention decision, recorded here rather than silently assumed.

The explicit-only guarantee is contractual (tool description + docs/b1-runbook.md), not an audited property of omp: no claim is made that all omp research traffic routes through assess_source; automatic interception remains unproven and out of scope.

trace_id (request-supplied) and otel_trace_id (exported span) differ by design in the B1 harness; inspect links and Phoenix correlation use otel_trace_id. Downstream consumers must key correlation on otel_trace_id.
Brain trust rows remain operator-seeded (B0 caveat inherited); placeholder LLM key never called on the read path.
No B2 portability, benchmark, or Gate C holdout evidence exists.

research.decision.authority=AUTHORITATIVE is still set unconditionally by the provisional adapter (B0 knownGap, inherited); guard required before any Layer-2-shaped preflight is emitted through this surface.
proves: Exactly one real agent client (omp 18.3.0) completed an explicit assured MCP workflow end-to-end: stdio MCP server -> canonical SourceAssuranceBackend port -> provisional INITE Brain adapter -> live self-hosted Brain -> full assured-evidence report printed by the client -> OTel source.assess export queryable in Phoenix.

The B1 report contract: every observed and tested report carries assessment id, decision, owningLayer=1, scope=source-suitability, policyId, authority status, policy/evaluator versions (b1-omp-mcp), claim/source/intended-use, all nine dimensions with reasons (UNKNOWN never elided), failures list, evidence-root id, trace ids, and inspect link (4 visible dev tests over recorded payloads).

Fail-safe honesty holds through the client path: 404 -> BRAIN_SOURCE_UNKNOWN + ABSTAIN; misconfigured auth (401) -> INITE_BRAIN_UNAVAILABLE + ABSTAIN with all dimensions UNKNOWN; missing env -> fail-fast exit 1; ACCEPT never emitted in any observed or tested mode.
doesNotProve: That Layer 1 source-suitability judgments are accurate, task-matched, benchmarked, or adopted: client smoke success is not Layer-1 accuracy.
That the provisional backend is fit for warn/enforce; observe mode only.
That any host (including omp) routes all evidence traffic through Layer 1; the assured path is explicit-call-only.
That the report format is ergonomically accepted by a human reviewer (not separately solicited; see knownGaps).
B2 portability to a second client, Gate C benchmark/holdout quality, or organic learned-reputation pipelines.
